intro: Cypriot culture blends Greek, Turkish and wider Mediterranean traditions.

chapters.title: Food
text: Halloumi, souvla (slow-grilled meat), koupepia (stuffed vine leaves) and long meze meals are favourites. Commandaria, a sweet wine, is said to be the oldest named wine still produced.

chapters.title: Crafts and festivals
text: Lefkara lace has been made for centuries; legend says Leonardo da Vinci bought some for Milan Cathedral. Kataklysmos, a water festival, is held at Pentecost.

keyTerms.meaning: A firm, salty Cypriot cheese that can be grilled.
